title: Chapter 187 It'S Time To Go
content:
Chapter 187 It'S Time To Go

Lu Daosheng continued to ask.

"Yan Lingyun?"

Hearing this name, the Chaos Pearl Spirit was slightly stunned and then began to think about it.

"That little girl, I was a little confused by the disaster at that time, so I was unable to leave the chaotic void until I met her by chance and then I left there."

Chaos Void touched her chin, as if she was recalling the scene at that time.

"A coincidence?"

Lu Daosheng murmured, his wife is so lucky, she can just accidentally enter the chaotic void and encounter a legendary thing like the Chaos Pearl.

However, thinking of the disaster aura in the Chaos Pearl, Lu Daosheng's face suddenly sank.

These two things were put together, but they almost broke up their wife!

The key is that I almost didn't even notice it.

Immediately, Lu Daosheng grabbed the Chaos Pearl Spirit again.

"Do you know what the consequences will be if you are infected with the disaster aura?"

Lu Daosheng said in a fierce voice.

Hearing this, the Chaos Pearl Spirit's expression trembled, "Yes, what's the end? I'm the Chaos Pearl."

Obviously, the Chaos Pearl Spirit did not know what would happen if he was infected with the disaster energy. In his cognition, he was a legendary treasure and almost nothing could do to him.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng slowly let go of the Chaos Pearl Spirit.

Although this Chaos Pearl Spirit looks unreliable, it is indeed very useful.

If it weren't for it, my wife would have died in her first life.

And I am even more unlikely to meet Yan Lingyun.

However, if the Chaos Pearl has been like this, it will definitely suffer in the future.

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng said slowly: "Will you continue to follow Yan Lingyun in the future?"

Hearing this, the Chaos Pearl Spirit had almost no hesitation.

"certainly!"

"Why?"

Lu Daosheng asked.

The Chaos Pearl Spirit's expression was rarely solemn.

"Since I was born, I have seen countless amazing geniuses rise and fall, but Yan Lingyun is the most terrifying one I have ever seen. Looking at the entire history, those so-called geniuses are in my eyes, even She doesn't deserve it if she carries her shoes."

"Follow her, I have a future."

The last sentence is concise and to the point.

When Lu Daosheng heard the words of the Chaos Pearl Spirit, he felt relieved.

"Okay, then you can follow her in the future."

Chaos Pearl Spirit was stunned for a moment and said carefully: "Boss, what is your relationship with her?"

Although I had long guessed that the mysterious and terrifying boss in front of me had a different relationship with Yan Lingyun, the Chaos Pearl Spirit still asked.

I saw Lu Daosheng smiled slightly.

"Yan Lingyun is my wife."

Suddenly, the Chaos Pearl Spirit looked shocked.

In this case, it seems that I will have a better attitude towards Yan Lingyun in the future.

After the matter was resolved, Lu Daosheng did not say nonsense and directly took the Chaos Pearl to the Desolate City.

And at this time.

Above the deserted city.

Yan Lingyun was still sitting cross-legged in the void.

The immortal gate above the sky exuded strong fluctuations, as if tempting Yan Lingyun to break through the immortal gate as soon as possible and ascend to the immortal world.

However, Yan Lingyun was indifferent.

"Hmm? Come back."

At this time, the Heavenly Dao beside him spoke.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun slowly opened her eyes and looked down.

The next moment, Yan Lingyun's body trembled and she immediately came to the palace of the Lord of the Huangcheng City.

"Daosheng."

Seeing Lu Daosheng, Yan Lingyun immediately smiled.

"Solved?"

Lu Daosheng nodded, "That's natural."

After handing the Chaos Pearl in his hand to Yan Lingyun, Lu Daosheng chuckled and said, "He is fine now."

Yan Lingyun picked up the Chaos Pearl, felt it, and immediately realized that the strange aura had disappeared.

At this time, the Chaos Pearl Spirit flew out from the Chaos Pearl.

"Haha, little girl, long time no see."

"A Ling, you've really recovered."

Yan Lingyun was also very happy to see that the Chaos Pearl Spirit was safe and sound.

Hearing this, the Chaos Pearl Spirit immediately put on a masterful face.

"That's nature, my spirit is a Chaos Bead, merely,"

"cough!"

At this time, Lu Daosheng, who was standing beside him, suddenly coughed.

The voice of the Chaos Pearl Spirit suddenly came to an abrupt end.

"Uh, then what, ah haha, it's up to your man to be blessed, otherwise my spirit will be finished."

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun immediately laughed.

This Chaos Pearl Spirit has really not changed at all.

The Chaos Pearl Spirit carefully looked at Lu Daosheng beside him, and saw that Lu Daosheng was not angry, so he breathed a sigh of relief.

I really didn't expect that this girl was so lucky that she not only encountered a legendary treasure like herself, but also could become a connection with such a terrifying existence.

Alas, things are unpredictable.

Perhaps, this girl can really become a peerless strong man.

"Several people, now the crisis has been resolved, so I'll leave first."

At this time, Tiandao, who had been silent on the side, suddenly spoke.

Of course, this sentence is directed at Lu Daosheng. If it weren't for Lu Daosheng, even the few people here would not be able to birds, including the Chaos Pearl.

"Let's go? You've made my wife so miserable, and you want to leave like this?"

Lu Daosheng's face suddenly changed.

Hearing this, Tiandao's face looked a little ugly.

"What do you want?"

Facing Lu Daosheng, Tiandao still chose to admit defeat.

No way, he can't beat him.

As for threatening Lu Daosheng, he didn't even think about it.

He knew the opponent's strength very well.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng had no expression on his face and said in a calm voice: "I will leave this world soon, but I will stay in the deserted city here."

Hearing this, Tiandao understood immediately.

But he was still a little hesitant.

"I am Tiandao, and I need fairness and justice."

Lu Daosheng meant that he wanted him to take a back door to the deserted city in the future.

That would violate his principles.

Seeing that Tiandao was somewhat unwilling, Lu Daosheng sneered.

Then he threw a dark purple crystal stone to Tiandao, which was emitting a strong breath of origin.

Suddenly, Tiandao's breathing became rapid.

"For me?"

Tiandao couldn't believe it.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng said in a calm voice: "You can also choose not to."

As soon as these words came out, Tiandao immediately put it away.

"From now on, I'll protect this place."

He knew very well how much the crystal stone helped him. In front of his insignificant principles, how could his future be more important?

After hearing this, Lu Daosheng didn't pursue anything.

Of course, all this is based on the fact that Yan Lingyun is fine now and has been greatly improved.

After Tiandao left.

Yan Lingyun slowly walked to Lu Daosheng's side and gently took Lu Daosheng's hand.

"I should go."

That immortal gate can't wait there forever.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled slightly.

"I'll accompany you."

"Okay."

Then, the two held hands and slowly flew towards the sky.
